title.zh-TW: 專案列表游標跟隨圖片

summary.zh-TW: 作品集常見的專案清單：滑鼠移到哪一列，就有一張圖片跟著游標移動，移得快時會稍微傾斜；換到別列時，圖片像捲軸一樣上下捲到那一張。手機沒有滑過，改成每列左邊直接放小圖。
summary.en: A common portfolio project list: hovering a row brings up an image that follows the cursor and tilts when you move fast; moving to another row scrolls the image strip to that project. Phones show a small thumbnail on each row instead.

text.zh-TW: 跟著游標的東西都用 quickTo：先建立好補間，滑鼠每動一次只丟新的位置進去，比每次 gsap.to() 省效能，也比較順。
text.en: Anything that follows the cursor uses quickTo: build the tween once and feed it new positions — cheaper and smoother than calling gsap.to() each time.

text.zh-TW: 圖片第一次出現時，起點和終點都設成游標的位置，直接出現在游標旁，不會從畫面角落飛過來。
text.en: On first appearance the start and end are both the cursor position, so it appears right there instead of flying in from a corner.

text.zh-TW: 所有圖片排成一直欄放在框裡，換專案時整欄上下移動。往下一列，圖片就往上捲，方向和清單一致。
text.en: All images sit in one column inside the frame; changing project moves the whole column. Going down the list scrolls the images up, matching the direction.

text.zh-TW: 手機沒有「滑過」，跟著游標的圖片完全不會出現。改成每列左邊直接放小圖，內容才不會在手機上消失。
text.en: Phones have no hover, so the following image would never appear. Each row shows a small thumbnail instead so nothing is lost on mobile.
